title: 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI Collision Repair
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair completed collision repair on a 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI damaged in a hit-and-run incident.
story: This 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI arrived at the shop requiring front-end collision repair following a hit-and-run incident. Initial inspection showed impact damage concentrated on the front right fender, headlight mounting area, and front bumper cover assembly.

The repair process involved disassembling affected components around the front quarter section, including removing the headlight assembly and front bumper cover for complete assessment. Technicians addressed structural alignment at the fender mounts and prepared replacement panels for paint.

After applying primer, a Metallic Dark Gray color coat, and clear coat, the team reassembled the headlight and bumper trim. Body gaps and panel alignments were verified before completing final cleanup.
